Sequential Unity RPG implementation phases (1-12), each phase's tool building on prior phases' systems

nodes.label: Death rule keeps stage restart local, never rolls back unlocks or banked XP/loot (§36)
nodes.norm_label: death rule keeps stage restart local, never rolls back unlocks or banked xp/loot (§36)

nodes.label: Rewards are claimed/banked before the reveal animation plays, so quitting mid-animation costs nothing
nodes.norm_label: rewards are claimed/banked before the reveal animation plays, so quitting mid-animation costs nothing

nodes.label: Atomic writes (temp file then move) prevent a crash mid-write from corrupting the profile
nodes.norm_label: atomic writes (temp file then move) prevent a crash mid-write from corrupting the profile

nodes.label: DeleteSave only removed the file; ResetProfile now clears live state too, and Save() refuses to write with no class chosen, so a wipe actually sticks
nodes.norm_label: deletesave only removed the file; resetprofile now clears live state too, and save() refuses to write with no class chosen, so a wipe actually sticks

nodes.label: Saves store stable string IDs, never ScriptableObject references, so templates can change safely
nodes.norm_label: saves store stable string ids, never scriptableobject references, so templates can change safely

nodes.label: Sprite moved onto a Body child so animation never resizes the collider, matching why HitFlash only ever changes colour
nodes.norm_label: sprite moved onto a body child so animation never resizes the collider, matching why hitflash only ever changes colour

nodes.label: VSync must be off for targetFrameRate to take effect; Unity ignores the cap and syncs to display refresh otherwise
nodes.norm_label: vsync must be off for targetframerate to take effect; unity ignores the cap and syncs to display refresh otherwise

nodes.label: Completion screen timing uses unscaled time because ModalPanel pauses the game while the screen is open
nodes.norm_label: completion screen timing uses unscaled time because modalpanel pauses the game while the screen is open

nodes.label: Sprites regenerated at 4x in place because Phase 1 pixel sizes were being upscaled on high-DPI phones
nodes.norm_label: sprites regenerated at 4x in place because phase 1 pixel sizes were being upscaled on high-dpi phones

nodes.label: Health bar/feedback added to scene Player, not prefab, because the prefab is stale (later phases only patched the scene instance)
nodes.norm_label: health bar/feedback added to scene player, not prefab, because the prefab is stale (later phases only patched the scene instance)

nodes.label: Health bars built from SpriteRenderers, not a world-space Canvas, to avoid per-enemy mesh rebuild cost on mobile
nodes.norm_label: health bars built from spriterenderers, not a world-space canvas, to avoid per-enemy mesh rebuild cost on mobile

nodes.label: HitFeedbackEmitter listens to the victim's Health rather than attack code, so one component covers every damage source uniformly
nodes.norm_label: hitfeedbackemitter listens to the victim's health rather than attack code, so one component covers every damage source uniformly
